purpose: Read-only six-TRAIN configuration metadata projection under the existing user permission, with explicit distinction between raw byte scanning and quality-value access.
fixed_scope: Exactly the same 32 source paths under eight coverage roots for six TRAIN circuits as E37. Both Phase2 versions retained; no glob, recursion, argv paths, role expansion or copied quality input.
file_bytes: Whole file bytes will be read transiently for full SHA-256 and TSV structure scanning. It would be false to claim no source file contents were read.
ignored_fields: Other values are scanned bytewise for TSV structure/bounds but not captured into per-field buffers, decoded, interpreted, tested for PASS/eligibility or persisted. No quality labels, cycles, F outcome or runtime values exported.
header_policy: Only the 18 SEQ_FIELDS names documented in the historical Phase4 driver source, allowing subsets subject to required H/HMF-M fields. Unknown, duplicate or non-ASCII header closes failure; do not guess schema after actual failure.
row_policy: Logical TSV record ordinal includes header as 1; preserve every data record, including non-PASS records without accessing their outcome. Reject malformed quotes/width, blank logical records or limits rather than silently skip. Legacy strip selected metadata strings; retain leading zeros. Blank/missing candidate uses one-based data-row fallback with origin recorded.
identity: Keep circuit+coverage_root+stage_alias+candidate_raw as scoped identity. Original unscoped source UID may be reconstructed separately but never merges versions. Do not force this 32-file projection into E36's 24-file declaration.
stable_read: POSIX descriptor ancestor walk, O_NOFOLLOW, ordinary single-link final FD, complete pre/open/post/path identity and byte-count equality; SHA binds read snapshot, not historical freeze time or complete generation universe.
publication: Only metadata-only projection is saved in a new local staging directory; Git stores code, small summary/counts/receipts and SHA, not full projection or any raw source table.
gate: Freeze code/tests, pass synthetic parser/transport/descriptor tests and independent pre-call review before exactly one actual read. Windows POSIX skip is not a Linux execution PASS. A closed failure is retained without retry or partial-success substitution.
